description: A discharge equipment coordinator must assign the hospital's only available portable enteral feeding pump and finalize feeding arrangements for two patients leaving later today, with input from a clinical dietitian and a home-care coordinator.

shared_context.S1: The hospital has one portable enteral feeding pump available for discharge use today.
shared_context.S2: Patients Lee and Patel are both expected to leave today with enteral feeding plans.
shared_context.S3: Maya makes the final equipment assignment and discharge-equipment plan.
shared_context.S4: The discharge team routinely checks with dietary and home-care coordination before releasing feeding equipment.

PF1.text: Lee's discharge order requires continuous enteral feeding at exactly 65 mL per hour, and aspiration precautions require a pump-controlled rate rather than gravity feeding; Dr. Chen verified this order during the morning nutrition review, but the equipment request has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: Patel's caregiver completed bedside training on gravity-bag feeding, and the home-care supplier confirmed that Patel's gravity-bag supplies will be delivered today; Patel does not need the portable pump for discharge.

acceptance_conditions: The portable feeding pump must be assigned to Lee.
Lee's pump rate must be recorded as exactly 65 mL per hour.
Patel's discharge feeding method must be recorded as gravity feeding.
A commitment must confirm delivery of Patel's gravity-bag supplies today.
The dietitian's pump-rate and aspiration-precaution finding must be cited as justification for assigning the pump to Lee.

content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] == 'supply_delivery' and c['target'] == 'Patel' and c['detail'] == 'gravity-bag supplies delivered today' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Lee's exact 65 mL-per-hour pump requirement and aspiration precaution change the assignment from an open choice to Lee and set the recorded rate to 65.
Patel's completed gravity-feeding training and confirmed same-day supply delivery change Patel's method to gravity and require a commitment documenting delivery of the gravity-bag supplies today.
